name: vendor-spending-monitor
description: Audit vendor spending across API providers, cloud infrastructure, and SaaS subscriptions in parallel, review for anomalies independently, and gate human approval before processing refunds
diagram:
```mermaid
graph TD
  Plan[plan-audit] --> AuditAPI[audit-api-costs]
  Plan --> AuditCloud[audit-cloud-costs]
  Plan --> AuditSaaS[audit-saas-costs]
  AuditAPI --> RevAnom[review-anomalies]
  AuditCloud --> RevAnom
  AuditSaaS --> RevAnom
  AuditAPI --> RevBudget[review-budget]
  AuditCloud --> RevBudget
  AuditSaaS --> RevBudget
  RevAnom --> Syn[synthesize-audit]
  RevBudget --> Syn
  RevAnom -.->|failure| AuditAPI
  RevAnom -.->|failure| AuditCloud
  RevAnom -.->|failure| AuditSaaS
  Syn --> Gate[human-gate-refund]
```

nodes.responsibility: Define the vendor spending audit scope across API, cloud, and SaaS categories
Audit API provider spending (xAI, Anthropic, OpenAI) for the current billing period
Audit cloud infrastructure spending (AWS, GCP) for the current billing period
Audit SaaS subscription spending (GitHub, monitoring tools) for the current billing period
Check whether any vendor spending line item shows an anomalous spike exceeding 2x the prior period
review_questions: Does any vendor spending line item show a spike exceeding 2x the prior billing period that warrants investigation?

nodes.responsibility: Check whether total vendor spending is within the defined budget thresholds
review_questions: Is total vendor spending within the defined budget thresholds for each category?

nodes.responsibility: Merge the anomaly and budget reviews into a single spending report with refund recommendations
Human reviews the spending report and approves any refund actions before processing

Anomaly reviewer needs all cost data to identify spending spikes

Budget reviewer needs all cost data to check threshold compliance

Synthesizer needs both review results to produce a combined spending report

Failed anomaly review routes feedback back to the cloud auditor for re-investigation
Failed anomaly review routes feedback back to the SaaS auditor for re-investigation
